Comment: IAM policy for the EC2 instance role of the UCF Meeting & Action Item Tracker.
Replace ucf-mom-files with the real bucket name and attach this to a role,
then attach the role to the instance. Do not create an IAM user for this:
a role rotates its own credentials and cannot be pasted into a chat message.
The shape that matters is the split between the two prefixes. The
application reads, writes and deletes under files/ because officers delete
documents. It may only WRITE under backups/ — no delete, no overwrite of
history — so an instance that is compromised, or a script that is wrong,
cannot destroy the backups. Expiry is the bucket's lifecycle rule, which
this role has no power over.
JSON has no comments; strip this key before uploading, or paste the
Statement array alone into the console.
